title: First Steps in PURE GALAXY
note: Client-facing content (§17). Steps are checked off by game events; the world sim exposes those events, the client renders the tutorial.

steps.title: Survey your homeworld
steps.text: Open your capital and inspect its regions. Each district has a specialization and level.

steps.title: Develop a district
steps.text: Queue a district upgrade. Construction runs on your industry output even while you are away.

steps.title: Pick a research focus
steps.text: Set your science sliders. Crossing a milestone unlocks an empire-wide bonus.

steps.title: Colonize a neighbour
steps.text: Send a colony ship to a habitable planet in a nearby system.

steps.title: Make a friend
steps.text: Sign a non-aggression pact so a stronger neighbour will not raid you.

steps.title: Sell your surplus
steps.text: Ship surplus materials to your treasury and sell them on the Federation market for credits.

steps.title: Defend your space
steps.text: Newbie protection shields you early on. When it lifts, keep a fleet ready.
